remarks: A Front-Row Seat to Sterling Farms Golf Course.  Enjoy a rare opportunity to live along the picturesque fairways of Sterling Farms Golf Course, one of Stamford's most beloved public golf destinations. Perfectly positioned overlooking the 1st green and 2nd tee box, 109 Sweet Briar Road offers a unique setting where manicured greens, scenic surroundings, and the beauty of the game become part of your everyday backdrop.  Nestled in Stamford's desirable Newfield neighborhood, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers a wonderful blend of comfort, convenience, and lifestyle. A fully finished lower level provides additional versatile living space, ideal for a recreation room, home office, fitness area, or entertaining.  Beyond its exceptional golf course setting, the location is equally compelling. Enjoy close proximity to the New Canaan border, the Merritt Parkway, an array of restaurants and shops, houses of worship, and highly regarded public and private schools throughout the area.  Whether you're an avid golfer or simply appreciate the beauty and tranquility of an expansive, professionally maintained landscape, 109 Sweet Briar Road offers a distinctive opportunity to enjoy golf course living in one of Stamford's most convenient residential neighborhoods.  Best & Final due Wednesday Oct 21st @ 12:00PM
